name: virtualui
description: VirtualUI ( camera-locked cursor UI) sample screen

subcommands.name: sample
subcommands.description: Opens a sample VirtualUI screen - camera lock, buttons, icons, a scrollbar.

subcommands.name: close
subcommands.description: Closes your currently open VirtualUI screen.

subcommands.name: createdemo

subcommands.name: cursors
subcommands.description: Opens a gallery of every extra cursor.states icon ported from Kenney's Cursor Pixel Pack.
